book.name: HEBREWS
book.title: HEBREW sinmuy amuṅaqw Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēni

content: Pi uma navoti’yuṅqw, God Jew‐sinmuy amuṅaqw hakiy namorste’, put awwat mohpeq put moṅwtaviṅwu. Noqw pahsat pu pam sinmuy amuṅem God aw okiwlawṅwu; nihqe pumuy amuṅem hom’oyiyamuy God aw nóaṅwu; piw qaanhtipuyamuy ep hihtuy qöyaṅwu.
Nīk̇aṅw pam pay pumuy amún sínonihqe ōviy qa pasiwta; nihqe ōviy pam tutavot qa navoti’yuṅqamuy, piw put aṅqw lasyaqamuy ōkwatuwniqey tuwi’ta.
Pam sínonihqe nawus nāp qaanhtipuy ep hihtuy nīnaṅwu; pu pahsat sinmuy qaanhtipuyamuy ep piw amuṅem hihta nīnaṅwu.
Noqw soon hak God awwat nāmoṅwtapṅwu; nīk̇aṅw God hapi hakiy moṅwtapṅwu; ura pam Aaron put aw tavi; pu put aṅkyaqamuy pīwu.
Noqw ōviy Christ God awwat mohpeq moṅwtaviwhqe pay qa nāp nātsok̇ana, nīk̇aṅw pay God put naat pan put yukuna. Ura pam put aw paṅqawu: Um hapi ítii, it tāwat ep nu Unaniwhti.
Pay ura pi pam piw haqam paṅqawu: Um hapi pas sūs God awwat moṅwi, Melchisedec tuwiyat an’i.

Ura Christ nāt tūwaqatsit ep qátuhqe, God aw okiw nāwaknaqe, a’nö pakk̇aṅw pas naokiwlawu, hakiy mokiwuy aṅqw put ayo táviniqey aw öqalat pasiwtaqat aw’i; noqw nāwakinpiat hu’waniwa, pam Nay aw tuqayvahsi’maqw ōviy’o.
Pay as pi pam God tíatnik̇aṅw hīhihta aṅ k̇ānavotqe put aw tuqayvahsi’maniqey tuwi’va.
Pu pam hin hintaniqey an yukiltiqe pep pu’ pam aw tūqayyuṅqamuy sūs ayo óyaniqat pan Naat put eṅem yuku.
Pi God hapi put awwat mohpeq moṅwtavi, Melchisedec tuwiyat an’i.
Noqw itam as Melchisedec wūhak hin lavayhtotiniqw put paṅqawniqw qatuvosi, uma qa īts nanaptaṅwuniqw ōviy’o.

Uma wūyavo Christ aw tuptsiwni’yuṅwa, aṅwu as uma sinmuy tutuqaynayanīk̇aṅwo, pay nāt hak pas God lavayiyat pas pu’ pas umuy tutuqaynaniqat uma pepya. Uma titipostuy amunyuṅqe pīhut‐sa nānawakna; nihqe uma kurs hin hurut nȫsiwhqat k̇ātotini.
Pīhut‐sa akw qátuhqa súantaqat qatsit, pu qasuantaqat qa mātsi’taqey antaṅwu; pi pam qaöqáwi’taṅwunihqee.
Noqw pay tukwsiwyuṅqam hurut nȫsiwhqat soon qa k̇ātotini, pi puma yūmosa put nōnovaqe hihta lolmatnihqat, pu qalolmatnihqat mātsi’yuṅwa.
